    for x in range(9,16): g[y][x]=7

    for x in range(19,23): g[y][x]=7

    for x in range(1,23):g[y][x]=7

# copy/recolor shape 1, bottom-aligned in middle stripe: source bbox y2..6 -> y16..20

    ty=sy+14

# copy shape2, bbox y1..4 -> y24..27; recolor 7->9 and 3->3
for sy in range(1,5):

print(json.dumps(g))
